scheme_name: India International Jewellery Show (IIJS) Participation Support
overview: The India International Jewellery Show (IIJS) Participation Support scheme, administered by the Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC), provides financial and logistical assistance to GJEPC members for participation in IIJS Bharat shows, including IIJS Bharat - Premiere, Signature, and Tritiya. The scheme aims to enhance export opportunities, ensure long-term business planning, and offer preferential benefits such as rate locks, discounted participation fees, and exclusive facilities for committed exhibitors across multiple financial years.
objectives: Facilitate long-term business planning for exhibitors through multi-year participation commitments
Ensure economy of participation via discounted rates and preferential allotment
Provide rate lock protection against price fluctuations for two financial years
Offer exclusive benefits such as complimentary hotel rooms and food coupons at IIJS Bharat - Tritiya
Enable priority access to hotel bookings, networking events, and sponsorship opportunities
Support global sourcing and market access for gem and jewellery exporters
Strengthen IIJS Bharat shows as a premier global B2B platform
eligibility: Eligibility is restricted to GJEPC members who have completed membership registration or renewal and possess valid login credentials. Applicants must submit space application forms and advance payment on or before the specified deadline (30th April 2026 for IIJS Prime Assure Scheme and IIJS Bharat – Premiere 2026 single show) to retain preference for space allotment. Non-submission or incomplete submission by the deadline results in automatic rejection and loss of preference status.
benefits: Benefits include rate lock for participation rates across IIJS Bharat – Premiere, Signature, and Tritiya for two years (2026–28), discounted rates under the IIJS Prime Assure Scheme compared to single show applications, no security deposit for two years, early show entry (30 minutes prior to official opening), access to IIJS Prime+ Lounge for owner exhibitors, discounted Networking Evening Pass, 25% discount on Innov8 Launchpad booking slots, hotel booking priority (one-day early access), priority access to sponsorship opportunities with 5% discount, special Prime Assure listing in the Digital Exhibitor Directory, and parking facility at Bombay Exhibition Centre (BEC) for booths 27 sqm and above. Exclusive benefits at IIJS Bharat - Tritiya for Prime Assure exhibitors include complimentary hotel room (3 nights) and food coupons: ₹7,500 for 18–27 sqm (1 room), ₹17,500 for 36–72 sqm (2 rooms), and ₹22,500 for 108 sqm (3 rooms).
financial_support: The scheme offers discounted participation rates for members who commit to multiple shows over two financial years (2026–28) under the IIJS Prime Assure Scheme. While specific subsidy amounts or percentages are not detailed in the evidence, the primary financial benefit is the reduction in effective cost per square meter through bundled pricing and the elimination of security deposits. Payment is processed via challan form through net banking, debit card, credit card, or NEFT after login at https://registration.gjepc.org/login.php.
application_process: 1. Visit https://registration.gjepc.org/login.php and log in using existing username and password (same as used for membership registration/renewal). New members must register first. 2. Fill out the space application form for either IIJS Prime Assure Scheme (6 shows) or IIJS Bharat – Premiere 2026 (single show). 3. Submit the application form along with advance payment on or before 30th April 2026 to avail the Discount Benefit Offer and retain preference status. 4. Failure to submit or incomplete submission by 30th April 2026 results in automatic rejection without notice and loss of preference for space allotment at IIJS Bharat - Premiere 2026 (single show) or for the IIJS Prime Assure Scheme across IIJS Bharat - Premiere 2026 & 2027, IIJS Bharat - Signature 2027 & 2028, and IIJS Bharat - Tritiya 2027 & 2028.
required_documents: Existing GJEPC membership login credentials (username and password)
deadlines: The space application for all 6 IIJS Bharat shows for the year 2026–28 opens on 13th April 2026. Applications must be submitted on or before 30th April 2026 to avail the Discount Benefit Offer and preference status. Late or incomplete submissions after this date result in automatic rejection.
implementing_agency: Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC)
caveats: Submission of application does not guarantee stall allotment; allotment is subject to availability of space.

Exhibitors who cancel participation during the Prime Assure period (2026–28) or are not allotted space will not be considered Prime Assure Exhibitors for remaining shows and will not be eligible for any Prime Assure benefits.
The IIJS Prime Assure Scheme is optional and not mandatory for participation in any IIJS Bharat edition.

Due to renovation at Hall 1 of Bombay Exhibition Centre (BEC), Goregaon, during financial year 2026–27, IIJS Bharat – Premiere applicants at Hall 1 will be allowed to apply only for Retention / Change of Location & Less area (More area option not available).
No counter sale will be permitted during the Exhibition; violators may be debarred from participating in current and future exhibitions organized by GJEPC.
